## Where it comes from {#source}

{{< var data.rows >}} rows from a knitting factory's daily production reports, June 1 to August 28, 2022, published
by {{< var source.author >}} (Daffodil International University) on Mendeley Data under {{< var source.license >}}.
The dataset's description says 2023; the dates in the data say 2022.

**Cite it as:** {{< var source.citation >}} [{{< var data.doi >}}]({{< var data.doi >}})

## What one row is {#row}

One lot knitted on one day, on a machine of a given brand and size. Lots and fabrics repeat across rows.

## The columns {#columns}

{{< include _dictionary.md >}}

## What we changed {#changes}

- Kept {{< var data.columns >}} of 38 columns and named them with units.
- Kept **Composition** as typed in the factory's report. The published cleaned version files some blends in the wrong
  category.
- Saved as UTF-8, removed invisible spaces, made dates real dates.

Everything else is as the factory recorded it. Finding the problems is part of the session.

## Downloads {#downloads}
